description: A 2nd CE Roman villa complex constructed on the site of an earlier farmstead. From 200 CE older structures were demolished and masonry structures were built up. One of these was a semi-circular masonry structure that has been interpreted as a 'shrine', the closest parallels for the structure are the nymphaeum at Chedworth, and lustral basin at Darenth villa.
